Harvard Professor Leads New US UFO Council Amid Alien Theories

A Harvard professor known for controversial theories about alien life has been appointed to lead a new White House council focused on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP). The council has reportedly requested Pentagon data on unexplained aerial sightings. The professor's past statements have suggested potential extraterrestrial origins for some phenomena, while also acknowledging the possibility of human-made explanations.
